name: plugins-hub
description: Personal plugin hub for Claude Code and Codex: skills, agents, commands, hooks and MCP.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea via design-tree interview rounds.

plugins.name: code-migration
plugins.description: Run a large-scale language migration with the six-step process: create the map and the rules, stress-test the rules, translate everything, compile, run it, match behavior.

plugins.name: ecs-game-feature
plugins.description: Implement game features on the custom Go ECS in pkg/ecs: design interview via grilling first, then components, systems, wiring, and tests following repo conventions.

plugins.name: peon-ping
plugins.description: Game-character sound notifications for Claude Code events: hooks on session lifecycle, /peon-ping-toggle, /peon-ping-config, and an MCP server for agent-chosen sounds. Engine lives in a pinned git submodule.

plugins.name: refactoring
plugins.description: Apply a structured, language-agnostic refactoring pass to any package or set of packages. Use when the user asks to "refactor" code, wants a refactor guided by rules. Produces readable, understandable code — no corners cut for speed.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web research via the vendored websearch engine exposed as an MCP server (pinned submodule, launched via make mcp): /web:search for a quick grounded answer (sources read, cited, unverified), /web:deep-research for an adversarially verified deep-research report. A PreToolUse hook denies the built-in WebFetch/WebSearch and points the model at the plugin's MCP tools.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Working principles for code changes via the ub-mode skill (tracked as a pinned git submodule of github.com/unclebob/ub-mode): every change follows First Make it Work, then Then Make it Right, then Practice. The ub-setup command installs the external analysis tools (crapper, dryer, mutator). Use when the user runs /ub-mode or asks for the reduced principles.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for the next agent and resume from it later: /handoff:handoff writes, /handoff:pick-up consumes — script-managed queue of up to 3 per-project files in the OS temp dir.

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries: binaries, Electron/JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies, packaged apps, firmware, and websites, via the rea-agents MCP server installed from npm.

plugins.name: channel
plugins.description: Telegram remote control for agent sessions: hooks + tmux paste deliver messages into the session and replies back, with a resident MCP bridge fallback; both keep the bundled channelsrv daemon alive.
